blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Five x plus three equals two x plus fifteen. Solve for x.
Both sides have x, so collect the x terms on one side. Subtract two x from both sides. Three x plus three equals fifteen.
Now undo the plus three. Subtract three from both sides: three x equals twelve.
Divide both sides by three. x equals four.
Watch out for these traps. If you add two x to both sides instead of subtracting it, you get twelve over seven. If you add three instead of subtracting it, you get six.
